title: UI critique (Low): Projects sparse state leaves a large blank region
description: With one project the Projects screen is a row plus the storage notice and then empty white to the fold at 1440x900; it reads as unfinished rather than calm. Screenshot: docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-ui-polish/screens/browser-projects-light-plain.png. Suggested: centre the short list vertically or carry a subtle material in the list column. Reference: iA Writer/Bear fill the column with typographic rhythm.

handoff.text: Rejected: centring makes the header jump as projects are added. Measured on a private build of the current tree (ui-crit-review/dist, includes T092 in-progress styles.css), 1440x900, Playwright: 'Projects' h1 y = 401.7 px at 1 project, 376.7 at 2, 351.7 at 3, 153 at 14 (brand 326.7 -> 276.7 -> 78). So the heading moves 50 px between 1 and 3 projects, 25 px per added project, and ~249 px between 1 and 14; the brand/toolbar/search move with it, so the screen's anchor shifts every time a project is created or deleted or the search filter narrows the list. Control (same build, the three new .library rules neutralised): h1 = 153 px at both 1 and 3 projects. Suggested instead: keep content top-aligned (header fixed at the 14-project position) and address the sparse look with a bounded column, e.g. a max-width on the list column / modest top offset, or a quiet empty-region treatment, none of which move the header. Tests on this build: projects-screen, layout, sidebar-selection, accessibility pass; features.spec has 2 failures that are T094/T095 in-progress tests (Settings captions, Goals select font), unrelated to library.css. tsc 0. Script and shots: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui-crit-review/measure, shots/t089-*.png.

review.note: Cycle 2 verified. library.css has no Launch-screen balance block, no min-height or auto margins; it holds only search, create-panel and drop styles, no placeholder or decoration rules. The 'heading stays put' test exists, and failfirst.log shows Received 50 against Expected <= 1 on the centred tree. Pinned Node: tsc 0, rebuild exit 0, projects-screen + layout one worker no retries: 36 passed. projects-1.png and projects-14.png have the header at the same position (Projects h1 at y~172).

log.note: Launch-screen balance: .library now uses flex column + min-height 100% with auto margins on first/last child (src/components/library.css append) - short libraries sit vertically centred (consistent with the existing .empty-editor centring), and auto margins collapse to top-aligned scrolling when the list outgrows the viewport. Verified on the ui-t10 private dist (rebuild exit 0): SHORT measure = block centred (292.7 px above / 308.7 px below at 1440x900, screenshot shots-t089/t089-short.png viewed); LONG = 14 projects, first row fully visible at 215 px (not clipped, assertion passed), scrollHeight 1019, screenshot shots-t089/t089-long.png. tsc 0; designTokens 3/3 (library.css adds no font sizes).
